title: Preparation requests
description: Team captains send requests through the public form without an account. Review each request and decide with a written reason. An accepted request becomes an active Academy team.

stats.title: Request statuses
stats.newHint: Waiting to be taken into review

publicLink.title: Public link for students
publicLink.description: Share this link with team captains. No account is needed to apply.
publicLink.label: Link to the public request form
publicLink.selected: Link selected. Press Ctrl+C or long-press to copy it.
publicLink.openLabel: Open the public form in a new window
publicLink.hint: The link is built from the address you are using right now. When sharing it, use an address the students can reach too.

empty.title: No preparation requests yet
empty.hint: Share the public link above with team captains.
empty.filteredHint: Change the search or the filters.
empty.noOpenHint: Every request has been decided. Change the status filter to see decided ones.

checks.duplicateEmail: This e-mail appears more than once in the request
checks.archived: The student is archived in the registry ({name})
checks.facultyUnavailable: The faculty is no longer active: {faculty}
checks.otherRequest: Also listed in another open request: {codes}
checks.captainElsewhere: Captain of another team: {team}. On acceptance that captaincy is removed.
checks.existing: Already registered as a student ({name}). The existing record will be used, not duplicated.
checks.facultyArchived: The team's faculty was archived after submission: {faculty}
checks.untracked: The competition's 2027 rules are not tracked yet. Accepting the request starts tracking them.
checks.teamNameTaken: A team with this name already exists: {team}

summary.blocking: {count, plural, one {# blocking conflict} other {# blocking conflicts}}
summary.clean: No conflicts found in the registry
summary.blockingHint: Acceptance is not possible until the conflict is resolved. Return the request for changes or fix the registry first.
summary.warningsHint: Acceptance is possible, but review the warnings before deciding.
summary.cleanHint: Member e-mails were checked against the registry and other open requests.

detail.untrackedHint: Tracking can be started on acceptance.

decision.title: Decision
decision.waitingStudents: When the students fix the request through their tracking link and resubmit it, it returns to "Submitted".
decision.acceptAfterReview: Only a request taken into review can be accepted.
decision.blocked: {count, plural, one {Acceptance is not possible until # blocking conflict is resolved.} other {Acceptance is not possible until # blocking conflicts are resolved.}}

NEEDS_CHANGES.title: {code}: needs changes
NEEDS_CHANGES.description: Team "{team}" will see your note on their tracking link and can fix and resubmit the request.
NEEDS_CHANGES.hint: Write clearly what must be changed (10–1000 characters).

REJECTED.title: {code}: reject the request
REJECTED.description: The request of team "{team}" will be closed. This decision cannot be undone; the students will see the reason on their tracking link.
REJECTED.hint: Write the reason for the decision (10–1000 characters).

ACCEPTED.title: {code}: accept the request
ACCEPTED.description: "{team}" will be registered as an active Academy team.
ACCEPTED.students: {created, plural, =0 {no new student records} one {# new student record is created} other {# new student records are created}}; {linked, plural, =0 {no existing records} one {# existing record is linked to the team} other {# existing records are linked to the team}}
ACCEPTED.mentorHint: Optional. The mentor gets a notification; you can also assign one later on the team page.
ACCEPTED.mentorOption: {name} ({count, plural, =0 {no teams} one {# team} other {# teams}})
ACCEPTED.hint: Write the reason for acceptance (10–1000 characters). The students will see it on their tracking link.
ACCEPTED.tracking: Tracking of the competition's 2027 rules starts, with you as the owner (a team can only target a tracked competition).

final.ACCEPTED: The request was accepted and became an Academy team.
final.acceptedNoTeam: The request was accepted, but the linked team no longer exists (deleted).
final.REJECTED: The request was rejected. This is a final status.
final.WITHDRAWN: The students withdrew the request. This is a final status.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.stale: The request changed meanwhile. Reload the page and review it again.
errors.transition: This status change is not allowed.
errors.noteShort: The reason must be at least {min} characters.
errors.noteLong: The reason can be at most {max} characters.
errors.acceptFromReview: Only a request with status "Under review" can be accepted.
errors.mentor: The selected mentor is not active.
errors.blocked: There is a blocking conflict: acceptance is not possible. Reload the page and review the warnings.
errors.alreadyLinked: This request is already linked to a team.
errors.emailConflict: One member's e-mail was registered meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.faculty: A faculty in the request is archived or belongs to another university. Reload the page and review the warnings.
errors.competition: A team can only target a tracked catalog competition.
errors.memberInvalid: A member can no longer join the team (archived, already in a team or at another university). Reload the page and review the warnings.
